nodes.title: 💡Info
widgets_values:
Bypassing SageAttention/Triton improves quality but increases generation time.

SageAttention and Trition speed up generation, but are not installed in the standard ComfyUI. If you don't know how to install them, it's best to ask an AI. I asked [perplexity.ai](https://perplexity.ai) and was successfully guided through the installation step by step. Since the installation varies depending on the system, universal instructions cannot be provided here. Be sure to create a backup of ComfyUI beforehand, as problems during installation can also cause ComfyUI to stop working.

⚠️‼️If the output image is completely black, this indicates an error with the `sage_attention` model. You should then select the model variant that matches your system configuration. Bypass the group if SageAttention and Triton are not installed‼️⚠️

nodes.title: ℹ️Workflow INFO
widgets_values:
# PhotoFlow Chroma HD Flash v1.0

This text-to-image workflow is designed to generate images with a strong focus on realism. To speed up the generation process, the Chroma Flash LoRA is used. To enhance realism, Danrisi's Lenovo UtraReal LoRA is essential. A big thank you to the authors ♥️!

## Recommended Model Downloads

### Chroma HD
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`:  

If you have 24GB or more VRAM the bf16 safetenors model is recommended.  
[Download](https://civitai.com/models/1330309?modelVersionId=2164239) `chroma_v10HD.safetensors`  

If you have less than 24GB of VRAM the fp8 safetenors model is recommended.  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/Clybius/Chroma-fp8-scaled/resolve/main/Chroma1-HD/Chroma1-HD_float8_e4m3fn_scaled_learned_topk8_svd.safetensors?download=true) `Chroma1-HD_float8_e4m3fn_scaled_learned_topk8_svd.safetensors`  

A much slower alternative with little bit better quality is the Q8_0 GGUF model:    
[Download](https://huggingface.co/silveroxides/Chroma-GGUF/resolve/main/Chroma1-HD/Chroma1-HD-Q8_0.gguf?download=true) `Chroma1-HD-Q8_0.gguf`   

If you have less than 6GB of VRAM, the Q4_0 GGUF model is recommended.  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/silveroxides/Chroma-GGUF/resolve/main/Chroma1-HD/Chroma1-HD-Q4_0.gguf?download=true) `Chroma1-HD-Q4_0.gguf`

### Flux Text Encoder
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/text_encoders`:  

fp8:  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors?download=true) `t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors`  

or fp16 (best prompt adaption, slower):  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/t5xxl_fp16.safetensors?download=true) `t5xxl_fp16.safetensors`

### Flux VAE
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\vae`:  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lumina_Image_2.0_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors?download=true) `ae.safetensors`  

### Flash LoRA (⚠️mandatory for default settings in this workflow)
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\loras`:  
[Download](https://civitai.com/models/2032955?modelVersionId=2300965) `chroma-flash-heun_r64-fp32.safetensors`  

### Lenovo UltraReal LoRA
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\loras`:  
[Download](https://civitai.com/models/1662740?modelVersionId=2299345) `lenovo_chroma.safetensors`   

### Upscalers
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\upscale_models`:  
[Download](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-UniversalUpscalerV2-Neutral) `4x_UniversalUpscalerV2-Neutral_115000_swaG.pth`  
[Download](https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1) `1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1.pth` 

## Installation

### ComfyUI Manager Installation
[https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager)

### Installation of Missing Nodes

Missing nodes in this workflow are highlighted in red. To install them, open the ComfyUI Manager and click the 'Install Missing Custom Nodes' button. 

After the installation, restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser page.
